title: check: judge records by git history; warnings vs errors
description: Per DESIGN.md (2026-10-22): D6 a tier record is valid if its approver held authority at the commit that added it (approver stepping down voids nothing; only revocation voids); a tier record committed before its person file exists is ignored; a key listed in two files belongs to the file that listed it first; a revocation signed by a key later revoked counts if committed before that key's revocation; revocations are read from history so deleting the file does not undo one; void records and revoked-key-still-listed are reported, never fatal. check exits non-zero only on errors and prints warnings (D1, unendorsed emails, voided records, fetch age) separately. Replaces the hard failure at git-vouch:967-972.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture git registries cover each rule with real ssh-keygen signatures; approver removal no longer fails check; exit status distinguishes errors from warnings.
notes: Implemented in git-vouch: History/registry_history. Positions = git rev-list --topo-order --reverse --parents HEAD plus the working tree (final); ORDER IS ANCESTRY (History.before/concurrent, one ancestor bitset per commit), never the topo index, because merge shape is author-controlled. Merges that kept one parent's content are added as versions (git log --merges -m, blobs via read_blobs, factored out of file_history) so History.at is exact; History.added traces such merges back to the commits that introduced the content (tuple; two branches can add the same bytes). check_registry: tier record valid if approver may grant at every adding commit AND no concurrent commit lowered the approver's authority (error otherwise); before-person-file -> void; automation accountable must be maintainer/anchor at the adding commit (error) and have a valid tier at the tree (void otherwise, vouch-ey47.16). Key ownership: first listing over every person-file version in history, by ancestry; tied (same commit or concurrent) -> current-key rule. Revocations: key must be owned by the subject, signer keys owned by their lister; void only if the signer was revoked in an ancestor commit; concurrent/same-commit count (vouch-ey47.17); rejected historical revocations are warnings. Review round 1 (7 findings) all fixed; tests in tests/test_check_history.py (22, real git + ssh-keygen), each fix mutation-checked. Open questions: vouch-ey47.16, .17, .18.
